input.summary: Extend licence to contractors acting for Sparkling and permit assignment to a successor in an M&A transaction.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to contractors and outsourcing providers using the Software on our behalf, and added a consent-free assignment right to a successor in a merger or sale of the business, with a conforming carve-out in Section 3(c). Our playbook requires licences to cover affiliates and contractors and to travel with the business; the licence otherwise remains limited to the Authorized Locations.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors and outsourcing providers acting on Sparkling's behalf, in each case operating at Authorized Locations

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: except as permitted by Section 20(d) or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

ops.oldText: without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: without the written consent of the other party, provided that either party may assign this Agreement, together with the licence granted hereunder, without consent to a successor in connection with a merger, amalgamation, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates.
